turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're building a conversational agent product on top of 12Labs — how's the latency been for that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's the number one thing our beta users complain about. There's a noticeable pause before the agent starts speaking, long enough that people start repeating themselves thinking it didn't hear them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has this affected your launch plans?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We delayed our public launch by a month specifically to wait for a lower-latency streaming tier we were told was coming.
